scope_reconciliation: The paper reports100km for T24, approximately200km for the turn south of Sri Lanka, and250km for a broader south-and-west discussion. Preserve all three source statements and their different support; do not average, pool, choose annual extrema or claim their methods and footprints are identical.
excluded_confounders: The300km northward current east of EICC is a different flow, not EICC width.
The outbound T18 transect only clipped EICC's eastern edge; it does not provide a second100km width observation.
Model-only100km/200km descriptions repeat or contextualize the observations; they are not extra independent observational samples.
The17-24December cruise bounds are not the specific T24 width-support bounds.
Figure contours at0.5 or1m/s are not adopted as a width edge threshold without explicit source support.
Section2 transect longitude bounds and table2 averaging boxes are not current edge coordinates.
Table2 contains inconsistent printed years in some drifter end dates; those are not silently repaired or used as width timestamps.
next_gate: Prepare source evidence report/diagram without geographic interpolation; after canonical EICC identity admission, assess each statement separately for source-qualified width delivery. Do not count a combined discussion statement as a new measurement.
